import socket, struct

def dns_full(name, server="127.0.0.11", qtype=1):
    header = struct.pack(">HHHHHH", 0x9999, 0x0100, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    q = b""
    for part in name.rstrip(".").split("."):
        q += bytes([len(part)]) + part.encode()
    q += b"\x00" + struct.pack(">HH", qtype, 1)
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    s.settimeout(3)
    try:
        s.sendto(header + q, (server, 53))
        data, _ = s.recvfrom(4096)
    except Exception as e:
        return f"ERR {e}"
    finally:
        s.close()
    tid, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack(">HHHHHH", data[:12])
    rcode = flags & 0xF
    # parse answers
    off = 12
    # skip questions
    for _ in range(qd):
        while data[off] != 0:
            off += data[off] + 1
        off += 5
    answers = []
    for _ in range(an + ns + ar):
        while True:
            b0 = data[off]
            if b0 & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
                off += 2; break
            elif b0 == 0:
                off += 1; break
            else:
                off += b0 + 1
        rtype, rclass, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack(">HHIH", data[off:off+10])
        off += 10
        rdata = data[off:off+rdlen]
        off += rdlen
        answers.append((rtype, rdata))
    return rcode, an, ns, ar, answers

for name in ["prices.internal", "c952e98c76f1", "localhost", "ip6-loopback"]:
